note: These are 1976 Bắc Ninh village singers recorded for UNESCO in the newer staged style with folk instruments; the older unaccompanied quan họ cổ is mostly heard live or in local recordings that are hard to identify track by track.

size.basis: UNESCO counts 213 melody variants carrying 400+ lyrics; Nhân Dân (2009) reports 200+ melodies and 500+ collected songs. Many melodies have been recorded more than once by state troupes, village clubs and broadcasters, but few are on labelled international releases (one UNESCO/Folkways LP, a few CDs). Core = the welcome, invitation and farewell songs every club sings.
